observations: body L1-L3, L16, L32: «Albatenio», «Ptolemaeo», «Schiaparelli» (L3, L16), «Procli» (L3, L32), «Graecos» and «Simpli-cius» are letter-spaced; the dash after «(1).» (L1) measures 10.0 pt. The o of «cognitis» (L2) prints broken; a speck stands in the right margin beside L2.
body L5: «τίνες» carries its accent on the first syllable, as printed (the indefinite pronoun is τινές).

body L7-L14: the r raised after the numbers is an upright r. With the printed numbers 64ʳ 10′ · 91ʳ 30′ : 34ʳ 4′ = 172ʳ 21′, not 277ʳ 33′; with 33;4, Ptolemy's least distance of Mercury in the parts of which the eccentric radius has 60 (55;34 − 22;30), the fourth term is 177ʳ 33′. Ptolemy's greatest and least distances of Venus in the same parts are 60 + 1;15 + 43;10 = 104;25 and 60 − 1;15 − 43;10 = 15;35, against the printed 204ʳ 25′; with 104;25 the fourth term of L13-L14 is 1154ʳ 49′ from 172ʳ 21′, near the «1150ʳ» of L14, and 1189ʳ 40′ from 177ʳ 33′. The printed numbers are kept. The dots of L11 are five.
body L22-L23, L31: «Ptolemaei» (L22, L31) is letter-spaced; the equals sign of «[= Almagesto]» measures 9.5 pt. The Greek Ὑποτυπώσεις (L31) is set as printed.
body L26: the o of «compendio» prints broken, like a point and a closing parenthesis.
body L29-L30: the dash before «Res» measures 10.3 pt; «al–manshūrāt» (5.3 pt) and «al–Bīrūnī» (5.4 pt), letter-spaced, have long dashes.
body L34-L36: the dash after «b)» measures 9.4 pt; the dash of «120–122» is joined to the 0 and runs 4.5 pt beyond it, as a long dash. A heavy bracket opens Schiaparelli's addition (L35).

notes_left L1-L3: the Arabic of the codex, «فيجعله مثل الارض ثماني عشرة منه», ‘and he makes it like the Earth eighteen of it’, is set as one run between «Cod.» and «. Sed», and «منه» after «Sed»; for «منه» Nallino reads «مره», ‘times’ (the as-Suhà of p. 288, L35, «duodevicies Terram»).
notes_left L4-L8: «Ptolémée», «Proclus Diadochus» and «Simplicii» are letter-spaced; «145-46» has a hyphen (3.4 pt), and the dash before «Fuit» measures 8.0 pt.
notes_right L1-L5: the a of «Borussicae» prints broken, like a question mark; «t.VII)» is printed without a space.
notes_right L6-L8: the Greek is set as printed. The ι of «Πτολεμαίου» did not print; only its accent stands, and the υ prints broken. The signature 37 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
